title: Delta's Bloom: The Verbena Inheritance
summary: In a world starved of water, a teenager with platinum-and-amber braids embarks on a desperate journey. Driven by kinsfolk chat and the promise of income, they traverse the void, seeking a destination that offers payback. Within a corrupt abbey-turned-spaceship, they face a grotesque monster and partake in biochemistry experiments, a prisoner of their unique situation. Gloom descends as they fight against a flooded playground and a bricked building, their knowledge tested to its limits. But through sheer will, the world begins to defrost. An obelisk stands as a marker, and a teacher now guides, as a new beginning is entrenched.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: In a desolate land, a journey begins, fueled by whispers of untold wealth and a desperate need for payback.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a desolate, water-starved planet with an ebony sky at golden hour. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, stands amidst the chaffed crumbs of a dry riverbed, gazing at a distant, glowing destination. The void stretches out before them, hinting at the untold income from a mysterious layaway plan. Kinsfolk chat about a ballad of old, while the promise of payback seems a mere powerpoint prompt, making their limbs weary as they unhitch a wonton supply cart. Their eyebrows furrow with concern as they read a tattered newsletter, detailing the plight of a local nabob.

scenes.sentence: Within a makeshift spaceship, a unique experiment unfolds, shadowed by grotesque forms and the weight of luxury's promise.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, in a dimly lit, corrupt abbey-turned-spaceship hangar. A grotesque gherkin-shaped monster's shadow looms behind them as they partake in a clandestine biochemistry experiment, trying to make the kibble more appealing. They move with nimbler speed, a prisoner of their unique situation, dreaming of luxury beyond the normal. A lapwing watches from a cracked window as they attempt a breakdance to distract themselves, collecting toner from salvaged printers. Their appraisal of the situation demands complete objectivity, knowing the nectar of success is fleeting.

scenes.sentence: In the chaotic gloom, a desperate struggle against rising waters tests their every ounce of knowledge and resilience.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up of the hands of a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, frantically trying to fix a bricked building control panel, illuminated by harsh, violet light. Gloom permeates the flooded playground area of the fishery, and a grumble echoes through the administration's halls. Envy for the simplest solution is palpable. Their knowledge feels inadequate, a kilogram of worry. They recall a wedding, a moment of relaxation now unquote, a jocular memory of kayaked joy. Now, injured and entrenched, they fight against the rising water, the building groaning under the strain.

scenes.sentence: Under the watchful eye of an ancient obelisk, the world defrosts, reborn through hope and shared knowledge.
scenes.prompt: Wide overhead shot looking down on a newly grown verbena field, surrounding a marked obelisk in the shape of a delta. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now a teacher, stands among a group of young lapwings, their ankles lightly visible. They magnify a small embryo, explaining its wonder. Frankly, the demonic influence is gone, a victim of the final vote. A dancer celebrates nearby as geeks randomize data from a strange dongle, watching the roofing of new structures being laid. The world begins to defrost, entrenched in a new beginning.
